text:
maria: Found these in the kitchen — custard-stained socks in the microwave. Pic attached. Anyone missing a sock? :eyes: (reactions: :eyes: :laughing:)
jamie: Is this the Custard Socks we've been hearing about in lore? :scream:
cleo: We must perform proper rites. Quick poll: bury in planter, wash & hang on the shrine, or send to Lost & Found?
omar: I nominate Sir Toasty the Second as official office mascot. Long live Sir Toasty. :crown: (endorsed by jamie)
ben-facilities: Not mine. Please stop putting clothing in the microwave. It trips the odor alarms. I'll be cleaning tonight.
jamie: Also, suggestion: mandatory pilgrimage to the pantry at 3pm Friday for communal judgment. Who's in? :raised_hands: (reactions: :thumbsup: :wave:)
maria: Putting them on the office Slack "museum" shelf for now. Also found a sticky note with: `microwave = suspect` — very technical evidence.
lunch-bot: Reminder: Friday 15:00 — Custard Sock Court. Free cookies for attendees. (auto-scheduled)
cleo: Adding this to lore: 'The Basilisk of the Pantry' now has a relic. Officially named and documented by unanimous council :thumbsup:
